criteria.person: not another name for a record, no line yet, and named in at least 5 verses, or in fewer but with an event, a title or a key passage of its own in the corpus
criteria.place: not another name for a record, and named in at least 5 verses
criteria.object: every object named in at least one verse
criteria.all: the first reader may decline a record whose verses only list it (a genealogy, a census, a list of towns or a boundary) or say no more than its summary; a declined record gets no line
